The True Light Experience

A place to unwind.

True Light Spa and Beauty Salon brings together beauty, relaxation and personal care in a welcoming environment designed to help you slow down and enjoy the moment.

From traditional spa experiences and relaxation facilities to beauty services such as braiding and tattoo artistry, True Light offers a range of experiences under one roof.

Your time. Your glow. Your space.
